m920222.いいえ、私に冗談を述べる機能はありません。\nディアス様、あなたがそう望まれまし:
No, I do not have a function for making jokes.
Dias-sama, you wished it so.
m920222.いえ、提督は機動戦の名手だと伺っています。\n私には直掩機も搭載しましたし、\n:
No, I've heard you're a master of maneuver warfare.
I've equipped us with escort fighters, too,
so I'm counting on you to command the air battle.
m920222.いえいえ何でもぉ！\nさぁ、みんな急いで！\n天使の妨害はあたしたちが止めるわ！:
N-no, nothing!
Now then, everyone, hurry!
We'll handle the angel interference!
m920222.いずれバレることですよ。\nそれにしても、ケラウノス様ってやっぱり\n何だかんだ:
It's only a matter of time before it comes out.
Still, no matter what Keraunos-sama says,
he clearly cares about humanity—
m920222.いつかきっと、あらゆる場所に、\nその光を届けられると。\n僕の知略が、その支え:
That someday, surely, that light
will reach every corner of the world.
And that my cunning can be its support.
m920222.いや、こいつは防ぐとか、そういうのは無理だ。\nひい爺さん、楽しそうに笑ってやが:
No, there's no way we can block this.
Look at that old man. He's laughing like he's having a blast.
I've never seen him look like that before.
m920222.いや、半神全員がそうってわけじゃねぇから。: No, not all of us demigods are like that.
m920222.いや、確証があるわけじゃないからな。\n事実だけを述べるなら――:
It's just that I don't have any proof.
If I were to state only the facts――
m920222.うぅん、もう、だめみたいだ。\n僕の魂は……炉に焚べられてしまった。:
Ugh…… it seems it's over.
My soul…… has been fed into the furnace.
m920222.うおぉぉぉぉぉッ！！\nダイオージ、試作型ブースター……リミッター解除！！:
Uooohhhhh!!
Dai Ouji, prototype booster… limiter released!!
m920222.うちの軍師が世界中の協力を取り付けました！\nこれで、地上の守りは万全ですー！！:
Our strategist has secured cooperation from all over the world!
With this, our ground defenses are airtight!
m920222.うちの軍師って……。\nはっ、ミルドリス様のいた\nフィアナ騎士団のフィネス様で:
Our strategist…
Ah, you must mean Finesse-sama, from the Fiana Knights where Mildrith-sama used to serve!
m920222.うっ……だって、\n王子が抱え込んでる仕事量って尋常じゃないから……。:
Ugh... It's just that
the amount of work the Prince takes on is beyond reason...
m920222.うわ、アリアが感慨深い顔してる。\nそういうの似合わないぞ？:
Whoa, Aria, you've got a wistful look on your face.
It doesn't really suit you, does it?
m920222.えぇ、どうか全力で。\n私もこの歌をもって応えましょう。:
Oh, please, give it your all.
I shall answer with this song of mine.
m920222.えぇ、僕もそう思いますよ。\nそれでも、それだけでは守りきれないものがある。:
Yes, I agree with you.
Even so, there are things that cannot be protected by that alone.
m920222.えぇ、十分に歌わせていただきました。\nそれでは、この先へどうぞ。:
Yes, I had my fill of singing.
Now then, please, go on ahead.
m920222.えっ……あ、あれ？\nケラウノス様の魔力が、魂が、消え始めて――:
Wh-What?
Keraunos-sama's power, his soul, it's fading away—
m920222.おいおい、指揮官が出てきていいのか？: Hey, hey, is it okay for the commander to show up?
m920222.おぉ……雷の女神、ケラウノス様……！: Oh… the Goddess of Thunder, Keraunos…!
m920222.おぉ、王子タチがディアスに目にもの見せたゾ！！: Oh! The Princes showed Dias what they're made of!
m920222.おそらく、魂を魔力に変えて……王子の神器に。: He must have converted his soul into mana… and poured it into the Prince's divine artifact.
m920222.おや、それは失礼しました。\nでは似たもの同士かもしれませんね。:
My, I apologize for the presumption.
Perhaps we are kindred spirits, then.
m920222.おや、人でなしの猫又さんに言われてしまいました。\nふふっ……でも確かに、私より:
Oh dear, called heartless by a kitsune.
Heh... but I suppose you're far more human than I am, Koharu.
m920222.おやおや、その語り口では、\nまるで戦場を詩にすることにしか興味のない、\n人で:
My, my. The way you speak of me,
one might think I'm a heartless creature
interested in nothing but turning battle into poetry.
m920222.おーるおっけー！\n飛行装置にイワフネの魔力を流しても、\nまったく問題なし！:
All okay!
Even if we flow Iwanune's magic into the flight device,
there's absolutely no problem! Super stable!
m920222.お前、その兜は……。\nそうか、ようやく本気になったか。:
You... that helmet...
I see. So you've finally decided to be serious.
m920222.お前がいるということは……。\nそうか、ラムイエルが召集したな。:
If you're here, that means……
So, Lamiel summoned you.
m920222.お前には似合いだよ、ガレア。\n負け続けたから、常に敗軍の味方をしたから、\nそ:
It suits you, Galea.
Because you kept losing, because you always sided with the defeated,
there were things only you could see.
m920222.お前に褒められると、ちょっとイラつく。: Being praised by you is a little irritating.
m920222.お前のことも、嫌いじゃなかったよ。\n思想家ではなく、\n誰かを救うために、戦士:
I didn't dislike you, either.
Not as a thinker,
but as the warrior who tried to save someone.
m920222.お前の歌は、崇める神のためのものではなかった。\n己の使命に殉じた男への、鎮魂歌:
Your song wasn't for a god to be worshipped.
It sounded like a requiem for a man who died for his duty.
m920222.お前は、弱いんだ。僕だってそうだ。\nひとりだけで、できないことがあるなら、\n:
You are weak. I am too.
If there are things you cannot do alone,
you should have relied on someone.
m920222.きっと、私たちと同じなのでしょう。: It must be the same for us.
m920222.きっと大丈夫よ。\n王子は仲間を見捨てない。\nあの子にも無茶はさせないでしょう:
She'll be fine.
The Prince won't abandon his comrades.
He wouldn't let her take such risks.
m920222.くっ……くそっ、慰めるな、恥ずかしい。: Grr… damn it, stop comforting me, it's embarrassing.
m920222.ここで、その旅路を終えるかだ。:
――Great God Dias.
You don't actually want either of those, do you?
m920222.こちらの魔力圧縮、完了しましたぁ……！\nい、いつ爆発してもおかしくないですけど:
Mana compression on our end is complete……!
It could go off at any moment, though……!
m920222.こちらも完了です……。\nは、早く撃ちましょう、維持するだけで手一杯です。:
Ours is done too…….
P-please fire soon. Just holding it steady is all we can manage.
m920222.この一発一発が、大陸地図を書き換えかねない威力だ。\n天の磐船から直接取り出した:
Each of these shots has the power to rewrite the continent's map.
After all, they're raw mana pulled straight from the Skyship.
m920222.この世界の、何かが、ねぇ……？: Something in this world has changed?
m920222.この人生で、一番怒っている。\nあいつの首を、叩き落としかねないくらいに。:
I am the angriest I've been in my life.
Angry enough that I might just snap his neck.
m920222.この地上を制するのはゴブリン軍団！\n天使なんかに渡しはしないわぁ！:
The Goblin Legion will rule this world!
We won't hand it over to those angels!
m920222.この弾頭は不安定だ。\n飛翔中にも魔力を消費する。\nできるだけ距離を近付けて！:
This warhead is unstable.
It consumes mana just by staying in flight.
Get as close as you can!
m920222.この戦い、勝たせてもらう。\n僕はすでに、背負いすぎた。:
I'm going to win this battle.
I've carried too much for too long.
m920222.この魔法通信……まさか、オルカレクスちゃん！？\n世界征服はいいんですか！？:
This magical communication… Could it be, Orcales-chan?!
What about world domination?!
m920222.これこそが、貴様らの愛する三女神の力の原型である！:
……Huh!? The Three Divine Relics have appeared!
There is no magical disturbance……no, I can't detect any!
It exceeds the limits of human perception!!
m920222.これは……そうか、\n雷の星の魔力がディアスへと流れ込んでいます！\n力を増幅し:
This is…… I see,
the magic of the Star of Thunder is flowing into Dias!
It's trying to amplify its power!
m920222.これは神の雷霆……。\n魔力障壁も、防具も関係ない。\nすべてに平等に降り注ぐ、:
This is the thunder of the gods….
A magical barrier or armor won't matter.
It is the thunder of judgment, falling equally on all.
m920222.さぁ、続きを始めよう。\n前回はケラウノスに水を差されたが――:
Now, let us continue.
Last time, Keraunos interrupted us, but――
m920222.さぁ征け！ 人類の翼、\n夜明けを紡ぐ者、暁をもたらす希望の艦よ！！:
Now, go! Wings of humanity,
weavers of the dawn, ship of hope that brings the morning light!!
m920222.さぁ王子、総司令官の出番だ。\n一艦だけだが、最強の王国艦隊に命令を。:
Now then, Prince, it's time for the Supreme Commander to step up.
It's just one ship, but give the orders to the strongest royal fleet.
m920222.さぁ行くぞ！\n今こそ叫べ、我らが勇気の証、最強の剣の名を！！:
Now, let's go!
Shout it now, the name of our strongest sword, the proof of our courage!!
m920222.さて、それはお前の言い分だろう？\n自由気ままに、\n音を奏でるのが好きなやつだ:
That's just your way of looking at it, isn't it?
There are plenty of people who play music
simply because they enjoy it.
m920222.さようならだ、みんな。\nどうか――自由なる空を――:
Goodbye, everyone.
Please――may you have a free sky――
m920222.しかし、これで話は単純になった。\nあいつ、次は軍略家でも思想家でもない、\nか:
However, this makes things simple.
Next time, he won't come as a strategist or a thinker,
but as the warrior he once was.
m920222.しかしラムイエル、\n余に無断で神聖騎士団を使ったな。:
However, Ramuel,
you used the Holy Knights without my permission.
m920222.じゃあ、俺たち肉体労働組は、\n計算が終わって、魔力砲をぶっ放すまで、\n敵から:
Then, us muscleworkers just have to
protect the Dawnbringer from the enemy
until the calculations are done and the cannon fires.
m920222.じゅんちょうだよー。\n二秒で戦闘出力まであがるよー。:
All set!
It can reach combat output in two seconds!
m920222.せんぱ――こほん、王子！\nお待たせしましたー！:
Senpai— cough, Prince!
Sorry to keep you waiting!
m920222.そういうことでしたら、お応えしましょう。: If that's the case, I shall be happy to oblige.
m920222.そうか、僕を選んでくれて嬉しい。: I see. I'm glad you chose me.
m920222.そうそう、すごーく高く飛ぶとね、\nだんだん空の光が、藍色に近くなっていくんだ。:
That's right, when you fly really high,
the light in the sky gradually turns indigo.
m920222.そうだな、ユージェンならたぶん、\nこういう変化を、詩的にこう表現するんじゃない:
Right. If it were Yuugen,
he'd probably express a change like this
in a poetic way, wouldn't he?
m920222.そうでなければ、ここまで心晴れやかに、\n最後の瞬間を迎えられたりするものか。: Otherwise, how could I face this final moment with such a light heart?
m920222.そこには、こう書かれていた。\n故郷を守るために力を貸してくれた、\n輝ける兜の:
It said this:
"The warrior in the radiant helm who lent his strength to defend our homeland,
an idol, a hero, a noble knight of ideals."
m920222.そこに私の「試作型ブースター」の\nリミッター解除状態が加われば、\n敵の飛行速:
With my "prototype booster" limiter released,
we'll easily outpace the enemy's flight speed.
m920222.そして、神が己の法に従うだけではない、\n変わることのできる存在だと、\n王子に: And we are those who were taught by the Prince that a god need not merely follow its own law, but can choose to change.
m920222.そして人は、なぜ愚かな存在なのか、か。: And why humans are such foolish creatures.
m920222.そちらにつけ、とでも？\n僕は人類の進歩を裏切った。\n前を向くことができる者す:
"Join us," is that it?
I betrayed humanity's progress.
I made every enemy of mine who dared to look forward.
m920222.そのためにも、この戦いに勝たないと。: That's why we have to win this battle.
m920222.その傲慢を、望みどおりに叶えられる。\nこの戦いが、きっと最後の機会だ。:
And yet, that arrogance can be fulfilled exactly as I wish.
This battle will surely be my last chance.
m920222.その戦いが無駄ではなかったと証明するのが、\n僕みたいな、貧乏くじばかりの男で、:
I'm sorry that it's a man like me, who always draws the short straw,
who has to prove that your battles were not in vain.
m920222.その手を零れ落ちる悲しみも、\n遥かな未来に待つ終焉も……。\n王子よ、全ては…:
The sorrow that slips through your fingers,
and the end that waits in the distant future…….
Prince, it all……rests on your choice――
m920222.その敗北は……まぁ、気にしていないと言えば嘘になる。\nでも、僕らの敗北はそれ以:
That defeat... well, to say I don't mind would be a lie.
But our defeat happened long before that.
m920222.その時のために、書き残しておけ、と？: So, to leave a record for that time?
m920222.それ、ハイになってるだけだから落ち着いて。\nさぁ、通信いれるよ！ パルセ、発射:
You're just hyped up. Calm down.
Alright, opening the comms! Paruse, prepare to fire!
m920222.それ、必要な材料あったら取ってくるよ？\nあっ……盗品じゃないからね、一応。:
If we need any ingredients, I'll go get them?
Ah... I mean, they're not stolen goods, just to be clear.
m920222.それから、お礼はケラウノス様にも忘れずに。\nヒュープ様や、天界の戦力が降りてこ:
And don't forget to thank Keraunos-sama.
It took a very long time for him to lower the barrier
so that Hyup-sama and the rest of the Celestial forces could descend.
m920222.それから、我が依代に伝言を。\nあなたの献身に、感謝している、と。:
And pass a message to my vessel.
Tell her I am grateful for her devotion.
m920222.それが嘘だと気付いた時には、\n誰かひとりの力で全てを変えられるほど、\nこの世:
By the time I realized it was a lie,
the world had grown too vast
for the power of a single person to change everything.
m920222.それこそ、ご冗談を。\nこの身は真に、\nディアス様にお仕えする唯一の天使なれば:
You jest.
This body is truly
the only angel who serves Dias-sama.
m920222.それでも……。\n王子は、人のままでなければいけないわ。:
Even so…….
The Prince must remain human.
A world under the gods' protection would change nothing.
m920222.それでも、負けることは、許されない。: And yet, I cannot afford to lose.
m920222.それに、その試作型にリミットを付けてあるのは、\n最大出力にすると壊れるからなん:
Besides, the limiter on that prototype is there
because it'll break at maximum output.
If you accelerate this ship, you'll crash!
m920222.それに、今通信が入った。\nねぼすけの我が同胞が、私を受け止めに来てくれる。:
Besides, I just got a transmission.
My sleepyheaded compatriots are coming to catch me.
m920222.それに、平和な楽隠居を未来でするために、\n今戦わないのは、元フィアナ騎士団員と:
Besides, I've changed my mind. If I want to enjoy a peaceful retirement in the future,
it wouldn't be right for a former Fiana Knight to sit this one out.
m920222.それにしても、変な魔物だったな。\n巨人みたいな体躯のゴブリンに……。:
Still, that was a strange monster.
A goblin with a body like a giant's...
m920222.それは、ちょっと心外です。\n裏切り者同士、仲良くしましょうよ。\n――まぁ、私:
That's a bit hurtful.
Let's get along, you and I, fellow traitors.
—Well, my betrayal is scheduled for later, that's all.
m920222.それを言ったら、ここに集まった者たちの中で、\n真にディアス様の理想を信じている:
If you say that, then among those gathered here,
I'm the only one who truly believes in Lord Dias's ideals, wouldn't you say?
m920222.そんなこと、しませんよ。\n互いに世界のやり直しを、失敗した仲ではありませんか。:
I would never do such a thing.
We are both gods who failed in our attempts to reset the world.
m920222.そんなの、真正面から受け止めるしかないだろ！\n人間のこと大嫌いなくせに、\n大:
We have no choice but to take it head-on!
He hates us humans, but he's come to love us in the end!
This is the final, furious assault of the Thunder God!
--- scene: A Changing World (battle, start) ---
m920222.ただ、それでも、\nあなたの選択が全て間違いだったとは言いません。:
That said……
I will not say that all your choices were wrong.
m920222.ただ、人の意志を束ねただけの力で、\nこの世界の法則を書き換えた、貴様の輝きに。:
The brilliance of you, who rewrote the laws of this world
with nothing more than the will of people gathered together.
m920222.ただ、何度も滅びを繰り返した大地には、\n地表全てを焼き尽くした雷霆の痕跡だけが:
A weapon that scorches the earth so completely that no record remains,
and resets everything.
m920222.ただ、私が十回ほど爆散しますけどね……。: Though, I'll probably explode about ten times...
m920222.ただ、私もひとつくらい、\n義理というものを果たさねばならないので。:
However, I must fulfill a certain obligation
of my own.
m920222.たとえば、要塞宮殿の障壁を、\n大出力の魔力砲で破壊した、とかねぇ！:
Perhaps they destroyed the Fortress Palace's barrier
with a high-output mana cannon!
m920222.だが、いずれにせよ敵は来る。\nあの障壁をぶち抜かないと、要塞宮殿には入れない。:
But the enemy is coming either way.
They'll have to break through that barrier to get into the fortress palace.
So we have no choice but to fight.
m920222.だが、それでも……。\nこの戦いは、この戦いだけは、\n王子よ、余と貴様の……偽:
But even so…
This battle, this battle alone,
is the true story of you and me, Prince.
m920222.だが、まだその発動には至っていない。\n星を焼き尽くすには、\n異なる星の力が必:
However, it has not yet been activated.
To burn away the stars,
the power of a different star is required.
m920222.だが、僕は人類の無鉄砲なところを愛している。\nどうしようもない馬鹿ばかりだが、:
But I love humanity's reckless side.
They're hopeless fools, all of them,
but I don't dislike the way their eyes shine when they talk about tomorrow.
m920222.てめぇ自分は天使だからって適当なことを……！: You're just saying that because you're an angel and don't have to worry about it!
m920222.で、調査結果ってのは？\nもしかして、今の魔物に関係あったりしないだろうな。:
So, what did the investigation turn up?
I hope it has nothing to do with the monster we just fought.
m920222.ですが、人には領分というものがあるでしょう？\n戦うのは戦士の領分、\n人の歴史:
But surely, people have their places in this world?
It is the warrior's domain to fight,
and the poet's domain to weave the history of mankind.
m920222.では、あなたが良き夜を奏でられますように。: Then, may you play a good night.
m920222.では、それをこの詩のタイトルにしておきますね。: Then, I shall use that as the title of this poem.
m920222.では、私の思い過ごしだったようです。\nディアス様は、人が理想を追う姿に、\n人:
Then it seems I was mistaken.
I thought you saw the future of humanity
in the way people chase their ideals.
m920222.ではケラウノス、\n貴様はなぜ、そちら側に立っている。:
Then, Keraunos,
why do you stand on that side?
m920222.でも、その希望たる王子は、\n果たしてどこまで戦うことができるのか……。\n後世:
But just how far can our hopeful Prince fight?
How shall I tell the story to those who come after?
m920222.でも、それはお前だけじゃない。\nお前が誰かの涙を拭いたいというなら、王子のこと:
But that's not just about you.
If you wanted to wipe someone's tears, you should have come to help the Prince,
shining your helmet as you did.
m920222.ということは……まずい、\n天使が飛行装置に取り付いているんだ！:
Which means… this is bad.
The angels are latching onto the flight apparatus!
m920222.とうとう、この時が来たな。\n要塞宮殿を叩き落とす日が……。:
So, the time has finally come.
The day to smash down the Fortress Palace…
m920222.とても素晴らしいことです。\nこの場所に立ち会えたこと、心の底から嬉しく思います:
It is truly magnificent.
I am genuinely delighted to have witnessed this moment.
m920222.とにかく、こんなところで\n足止めを食らっている時間はありません。\n王子、実力:
In any case, we can't afford to be held up here.
Prince, let's force our way through!
m920222.どちらが偽物なのか、\nあなたが一番よく理解しているはずでしょう。:
Of the two of us,
you should know better than anyone who the fake is.
m920222.なぜ、お眠りになる前、\n私に、彼らを集めるよう言付けたのですか？:
Why, before you went to sleep,
did you order me to gather them?
m920222.なぜ私は、あの御方の真意を疑い、\n異境の神に頭をたれてしまったのか。:
Why did I doubt His true intentions
and bow my head to a god of the other realm?
m920222.なに、簡単に倒されるつもりはないよ。\nこの戦いにだけは、負けるわけにはいかない:
What? I'm not planning on being taken down so easily.
I simply cannot afford to lose this battle.
m920222.なんだ、らしくないな。\nいつもの自信はどうした？:
That's unlike you.
Where's your usual confidence?
m920222.はい、名場面を見逃すつもりはありませんから。: Yes, I have no intention of missing a classic scene.
m920222.はい。\nヘルメルク、ヘラクレイアは離反、\nガレアは先程、戦死しましたが……。:
Yes.
Helmerk and Heraclea have defected, and
Galea just died in battle…….
m920222.はいっ！\n天の磐船、出力１００％！\nドーンブリンガー、最大戦速！！:
Aye!
Heaven's Rock-Ship, output 100%!
Doombringer, maximum combat speed!!
m920222.はい！\nアルレットさん、\nフィンタンの魔力演算器をお借りします！:
Yes!
Arlette,
may I borrow Fintan's magic calculator?
m920222.ははぁ！\n我らゴブリン軍団、最強の魔物～！:
Haha!
We, the Goblin Legion, are the strongest monsters~!
m920222.ははっ、じゃあ本人の口から頼むとしよう。: Haha. Well then, let's hear it from the man himself.
m920222.ははっ、それなら僕の散り様は、\n真似したくなるようなかっこいい男として書き残し:
Hah, then make sure to record my end
as that of a man too cool to imitate.
m920222.ははっ、尽力しよう。\nさて、旗艦艦長に提督が揃った。\nあとは総司令官殿、心の:
Haha, I'll do my best.
Well, the flagship captain and the admiral are in place.
Now, Commander-in-Chief, are you mentally prepared?
m920222.ははっ、私の艦隊は空へは持っていけないから、\nお飾りの兼任空軍提督だがな。:
Haha, since I can't take my fleet into the sky,
I'm just a figurehead serving as the Air Fleet Admiral.
m920222.は？ 別のって……物質界以外に何かあったか？: Huh? A different name… Is there something besides the Material Realm?
m920222.ばっ……お前じゃねぇよ！！\n守りたいもののために戦うって言ってんだよ！！:
Ba… it's not you!!
I'm saying I fight for what I want to protect!!
m920222.ふざけんな。俺様は戦士だ。\n自分が選んだもののために戦うのが、戦士なんだよ。:
Don't be ridiculous. I am a warrior.
A warrior fights for what they have chosen.
m920222.ふふ、ありますとも。\n私は詩人ですから、\nいただいた料金分は歌っていくもので:
Heh, there is.
I am a poet, after all.
I see to it that my work is delivered for the price I've been paid.
m920222.ふふ、反省しているなら赦しましょう。\nしかし、私の神器がその程度だと思わないこ:
Fufu, if you are repentant, I shall forgive you.
But do not mistake my relic for something so trivial.
m920222.ふふ。何だか、不思議な感じですね。\nこれから戦うことになるのに、\nこんな穏や:
Hehe. It's a strange feeling.
We're about to go into battle,
and yet we're just chatting so calmly.
m920222.ふむ……。\n心配はいらないぞ、諸君！:
Hmph….
No need to worry, everyone!
m920222.ふん……短い命を、神のくだらん計画に捧げるとは。: Hmph… To offer such a short life to a god's trivial plan.
m920222.ふんっ、歌合戦と来れば応じましょう！\n王子、ここなら外と違って空気の心配はいり:
Hmph, a singing duel, you say? Then I accept!
Prince, we don't have to worry about the air up here, unlike outside!
We can perform at full power, just like on the ground!
m920222.まさか、アンナホープネスたちが……！: No way… the Anna Hopeless and the others…!
m920222.まさか、帝国艦隊まで引っ張り出したのか。: I can't believe you even brought in the Imperial Fleet.
m920222.まさか、艦外で戦うつもりか？\nここは天空の果てだ。空気が薄い。\n人が生きてい:
You can't be serious about fighting outside the ship.
This is the edge of the sky. The air is too thin.
It's not an environment where people can survive.
m920222.まさしく、神の御業……って、ん、んん……？: Truly the work of the gods... Hm? Hnn...?
m920222.まずい……全員、何かに隠れて！\n神器の加護がなければ、この力には――:
――No.
There is no need, you foolish children of men.
m920222.まだだ……まだ神話は終わらぬ……。\n人の可能性を、貴様の輝きを余に見せよ！！:
Not yet…… the myth is not yet over…….
Show me the potential of man, the brilliance of you!!
m920222.まっかせて！\n研究の成果を見せるときだ！:
Leave it to me!
It's time to show off the fruits of my research!
m920222.まったくだ。\n何しろ世界を救ったんだから、な。:
Exactly.
After all, we saved the world, didn't we?
m920222.むしろ、作戦が大成功した輝きに違いないわぁ！: No, it must be the radiance of a great success!
m920222.もう、この世界に存在する理由がない。\nここにいる、理由がない。:
There is no longer a reason for me to exist in this world.
No reason to be here.
m920222.もう、たくさんだ。\n軍師の真似事をしたって、結局は無力なままだった。:
It's enough.
Pretending to be a strategist changed nothing. I was still powerless.
m920222.もちろん、誰も知らない！:
Everyone, the Blessing of the Thunder God
that Lord Keraunos left behind is deployed around us.
m920222.やはりか……。ガレアか別の指揮官か知らないが、\n各都市を人質にする気だろう。\:
Just as I suspected… Whether it's Galea or another commander,
they must be holding the cities hostage.
But we've already issued the alerts!
m920222.やれやれ、愉快な奴に好かれてしまったな。\n王子、地上は僕らに任せ給えよ。:
Well, well. I've been taken with by a rather amusing fellow.
Prince, leave the ground forces to us.
m920222.よく言うよ。\n君のどこに義理なんて言葉があるのさ。:
Easy for you to say.
Where in you is there any such thing as "obligation"?
m920222.よし、僕らは城門の対処に行く！\nホルミースは警備と連携し、\nこの辺りの魔物に:
Good. We'll head to the city gates!
Holmes, coordinate with the guards
and handle the monsters in this area!
m920222.よし、要塞宮殿への道は開いた！\nあとは――僕らが辿ったかもしれない過去を、\n:
Good, the path to the Fortress Palace is open!
Now all that's left is――to defeat the past
we might have walked through, right here, Prince.
m920222.よし！ よくやった！\nいや……どうした？\nドーンブリンガーが墜ち始めていない:
Good! Well done!
Wait…… what?
Isn't the Dawnbringer starting to fall?!
m920222.わっ、こら、やめろ！\n勝手にタイトルにしないでくれ！:
W-hey! Stop that!
Don't just use it as a title without asking!
m920222.ん……どうだろうな。\nまだ正確なことは言えないが……。:
Hm… I'm not sure.
I can't say for certain yet…
m920222.ん……存外、間違っていないのでは？: Hm… perhaps you're not entirely wrong?
m920222.ん、ここにいたのか。\nちょうど呼びに行こうと思っていたんだ。:
Hm, there you are.
I was just about to come find you.
m920222.ん、分かった。\nでは、待つつもりはないが、来るなら勝手に来い。:
Hm, I heard you.
I'm not waiting, but if you're coming, come.
m920222.アキレア、今なら降りてもいいぞ。\n身内を殺しに行くんだ、強要はしたくない。:
Achillea, you can still get off now.
You're going to kill your own kin. I don't want to force you.
m920222.アトランティスの「彼」もまた、\n滅びし都の最後のひとりとして、\nこの時代に、:
“He” of Atlantis, too,
as the last of the fallen city,
entrusted his wishes and hope to this era.
m920222.アラエルさま……ぐすっ、うぅぅッ、\n空は……青空は、ぼくらが守るからぁ……っ！:
My Lord Arael……grrn, ugh……
We will protect the sky…… the blue sky……!
m920222.アリアは、よく頑張ってると思う。\n書類の山を爆破しないだけでも、とても偉いよ。:
I think Aria works very hard.
Just not blowing up the paperwork is an achievement in itself.
m920222.イマまさに、次の天使出現報告が入っタ！\nゴブリン王子ヨ、報告ノあった地点ヘ向か:
A new angel sighting has just been reported!
Goblin Prince, head to the reported location!
Take command of the march!
m920222.イマ盟友タル王子たちは、\n要塞宮殿攻略のタメ、天空の果てデ戦ってイル。:
Right now, our allies, the Princes,
are battling at the edge of the sky to take down the Fortress Palace.
m920222.オーガスタ、王子にめいっぱい食事を与えなさい。\n美味しいものは、心を豊かにしま:
Augusta, feed the Prince as much as you can.
Delicious food enriches the heart.
m920222.オーッホッホッホ！\n天使なんて敵じゃないわぁ！:
Ohoho!
Angels are no match for us!
m920222.オーバーホール済みのぴかぴかだ！\n航空戦艦の直掩騎、彼こそ最適だろう！？:
It's been overhauled and shining like new!
For an air battleship's close escort knight, he's the perfect match, right!?
m920222.ガオレオン様に、デーモンシェフまで……！: Gaoleon-sama, and even the Demon Chef…!
m920222.ガレア、その名を授けた者として、\n貴様に逃げ道を用意してやった。:
Galea, as the one who gave you that name,
I've prepared an escape route for you.
m920222.ガレアは……そうか、死んだか。\nあれも、つまらん男だった。\nだが、誠実であり:
Galea…… I see, he's dead.
He was a tedious man, that one.
But he was a man who remained honest to the end, even to himself.
m920222.ギガエル様、クラールフ様に伝えることは――: My Lord Gigael, is there something you wish to convey to Lord Klaarf――
m920222.ギガエル様の魔力が、球体に……。\n星の形となっていきます。:
My Lord Gigael's magic power is forming a sphere…….
It is taking the shape of a star.
m920222.ギガエル様！？\nご無事でしたのね！:
Gigael!?
Are you safe, my lord!
m920222.ギャギャ！ マモル！ カエルバショ、マモル！: Gya-gya! Protect! If we can't win, we protect!
m920222.ククッ……ハハハハッ！\nならば超えてみせよ！ 人の器のまま、神の力を！: This is the very prototype of the power of the Three Goddesses you hold so dear!
m920222.クラールフ様を、信じ続けていたなら、\n今もあの御方の隣に、いられたのだろうか…:
If I had kept believing in Lord Klaarf,
would I still be by His side now……?
m920222.ケラウノス、偽りの雷霆が、\n余の真なる雷霆に届くと思うのか。:
Keraunos, do you truly believe
your false thunder can reach my true thunder?
m920222.ケラウノス、貴様はなぜ、\nそうも嬉しそうに微笑んでいる。:
Keraunos, why
are you smiling so joyfully?
m920222.ゼクメトぉ！\nえっ、物質界に降りてきて「ヌン」は大丈夫にゃ！？:
Zekme-tto!
Eh, you're descending into the Material World? Are you sure, "Nun"?!
m920222.ソシテ、諸君ラも知ってのトオリ、\n天使タチが世界各地ヲ襲撃してイルノダ。:
And, as you all know,
the angels are attacking locations around the world.
m920222.ディアス、お前の願いも、俺が背負っていく。\n共に、未来を見に行こう。:
Dias, I'll carry your wish along with me.
Let us walk toward the future, together.
m920222.ディアスが宙に浮かんで――\nみ、みなさん！ 急いで防御姿勢を……！！:
Dias is floating in the air――
Everyone! Get into a defensive stance…!!
m920222.ディアス様、質問をお許しいただけますか。: Dias-sama, may I ask you a question?
m920222.ディアス様が勝利すれば、無用な物語になりますよ？\n停滞した世界なら、物語など不:
If you win, that story will become unnecessary, won't it?
In a stagnant world, there would be no need for tales at all.
m920222.ディアス様！ お目覚めになったのですね。: My Lord Dias! You've finally woken.
m920222.トラムとミルドリスが奔走して――まぁ、後で説明する。\n今はとにかく警戒しておい:
Tramu and Mildris have been running around—well, I'll explain later.
For now, just stay on high alert.
Achillea, I'm counting on your warrior's instincts.
m920222.ドーンブリンガーの最終チェックを急げ！\n空で命を預ける船だ、装甲の傷ひとつまで:
Hurry up with the final check on the Dawnbringer!
It's a ship that entrusts your life to the sky. Don't miss a single scratch in the armor!
m920222.ドーンブリンガー艦長、パルセ。\n君は大丈夫か？:
Dawnbringer captain, Paruse.
Are you all right?
m920222.ヒュープ様！\nいったいどうして……。:
Master Hupe!
What on earth is going on…?
m920222.フィネス、来てくれたのね。\nもう戦いたくないって言っていたのに……。:
Finesse, you actually came.
Even though you said you didn't want to fight anymore…
m920222.プロメさん、船体との魔力ラインは？: Prome-san, how are the magic lines to the hull?
m920222.ヘルメルクはもとより、好きにしろと言ってある。\nヘラクレイアは……あやつも義理:
I told Helmerk to do as he pleased from the start.
As for Heraclea…… he is a man of honor, after all.
If he found a worthy battlefield, then so be it.
m920222.ホルミース、君だって\nラムイエルの呼びかけに応えはしたけど、\nその目的は、理:
Holmes, you answered Lamuel's call,
but your purpose was certainly not an ideal world.
m920222.マレス様……なぜここに？\nまさか、開戦前に僕の首を刎ねようと？:
Mares… why are you here?
Surely you didn't come to behead me before the battle begins?
m920222.レクテさん、エピウスさん、\nアルレットさん、船体の状況は？:
Rekte-san, Epeius-san,
Arlette-san, what about the hull?
m920222.レーヴ、約束を違わず、\n私に毎日祈りを捧げ続けたこと、忘れませんよ。:
Reve, I have not forgotten
that you kept your promise
and offered me prayers every day.
m920222.万全ですよぉ。\nこのまえのパーツ集め、結果的に大成功ですね。\n以前よりも魔力:
Perfectly fine!
The parts gathering we did earlier turned out to be a huge success.
Magic transmission is much more stable than before.
m920222.三神器を取り戻したディアスは、\n神たるガリウスと同等、\nあるいはそれ以上の力:
Dias, having reclaimed the Three Divine Relics,
possesses power equal to,
or even greater than, the god Galios.
m920222.不器用な男だったが、ちゃんと仲間はいたんだな。\n私はそういう心の機微とか、よく:
He was a clumsy man, but he had true companions, didn't he?
I don't really understand these subtle emotions, but...
I think it reached them, perhaps.
m920222.世界は、永遠ではない。\n我が統治も、王子の求める世界もまた然り。:
The world is not eternal.
Neither is my rule, nor the world the Prince seeks.
m920222.了解。\nおそらく、これが最後の魔力砲撃です。\nみなさん、発射後は速やかに退艦:
Roger.
This is likely our final mana bombardment.
Everyone, be ready to evacuate the ship immediately after firing!
m920222.事実、だろう？\n人の心がないとは言わないが、\nお前さんからは、どこか道から外:
And isn't that the truth?
I won't say you lack a heart,
but there's something... off about you.
m920222.人が何かを過てば、\nこの世界は、容易く終焉を迎える。:
……If humans make even one mistake,
this world will easily reach its end.
m920222.人が愚かさを捨て、\nこの世界を託すに値する存在になる時代が、\n幾度も滅びを経:
Perhaps, after enduring countless extinctions,
there will come an age when humanity sheds its foolishness
and becomes worthy of being entrusted with this world.
m920222.人に可能性を見出したがゆえに。: Because I saw potential in humanity.
m920222.人の力で、それを打ち砕いてみせなさい。: Show me that human strength can shatter that.
m920222.人の願いの結晶たるディアボロスは、\n人類の可能性を信じ、君に未知なる未来を託し:
Diablo, the crystallization of human wishes,
believes in humanity's potential and entrusted you with an unknown future.
m920222.人間を理解しようとしたのも、\nただ、ディアス様がそう願っておられたから。:
I tried to understand humans
only because Lord Dias wished it so.
m920222.人類を学べと命じはしたが、\nあのような下郎、何の参考にもなるまい。:
I did command you to learn from humanity,
but those lowlives would be of no reference whatsoever.
m920222.今、頭脳労働組が全力で計算を続けている。\nまだ計算途中ではあるが、\n魔力砲で:
Right now, the brainworkers are calculating at full power.
It's still in progress,
but it seems the magic cannon can destroy that barrier.
m920222.今ここに、最後の星となりましょう。\n終焉の星よ、神なる雷霆よ、我が身を捧げん。:
Here, let me become the final star.
Star of Demise, divine thunder, I offer my body to you.
m920222.今ならまだ、もう一度理想を追いかけられる。\n全てを諦め、停滞の世界に加担したこ:
Right now, you can still chase after your ideals one more time.
If you give it all up and join the stagnant world,
I'll pretend I never saw it.
m920222.今のセリフ、いただきました。\nおっと、返事をしないと殺されてしまいますね。\n:
I'll take that line.
Oh, I suppose I should answer, or I'll be killed.
With this, I've fulfilled my debt to Dias, so—
m920222.以前は、勝手に私の神器を奪っていったようですが……。: Previously, you took my relic without permission……
m920222.何、僕らには\nドーンブリンガーの防衛という役割がある。\n発射まで時間を稼がな:
Don't worry, we have the role of defending the Dawnbringer.
We need to buy time until the firing.
m920222.何かを良くしたいと思えば、\n必ず、どこかでその煽りを受ける者がいる。:
If you want to make something better,
someone, somewhere, will inevitably suffer for it.
m920222.何が裏切りだ。\n最初から味方ではあるまいに。:
Betray me?
You were never on my side to begin with.
m920222.何も残されていない者、世界を恨んだ者、\n絶望を抱いた者、その全てのために、\n:
Those with nothing left, those who cursed the world,
those who held despair in their hearts… for all of them,
I tried to end this world.
m920222.何年も前のことでしょう？\nユリクセスの率いる軍に負けたこと、\nまだ恨んでいる:
That was years ago, wasn't it?
Do you still harbor resentment over the defeat at the hands of Yurixus's army?
m920222.余がお前の願いに応え、ここへ呼んだ理由はそれだけだ。\nしかし、それとは別に、お:
That is the only reason I answered your wish and called you here.
However, separately from that, I have no intention of stopping
whatever schemes you harbor.
m920222.余が勝利し、地上の悪しき者を焼き払い、\n諦観と停滞の世界が始まるか……。:
Either I win, burn away the wicked of the earth,
and a world of resignation and stagnation begins……
m920222.余は、お前を観測者として招くよう指示しただけだ。\n人が神に抗う、その物語を記す:
I merely ordered you to be summoned as an observer.
To record the tale of mortals defying the gods.
m920222.余は、貴様ならば世界を変えうると思っている。\nだがそのためには、人の器であり続:
I believe you are capable of changing the world.
But to do so, you must cease to be merely a vessel for humanity.
m920222.例の流星について、調査団の第一陣からの報告だ。\nさすがは星の概念そのものとも言:
The first wave of the survey team has reported on that meteor.
As expected of a fragment of the very concept of a star,
tracking it wasn't particularly difficult, but…
m920222.侮るな。\n最近は興味が出てきた。\nそれに、接し方を知らなかっただけだ。:
Don't underestimate me.
I've developed an interest lately.
It's just that I didn't know how to approach them.
m920222.信じていたものにはたどり着けず、\n諦めた先にも、何も残っていない。:
You couldn't reach what you believed in,
and there was nothing left where you gave up.
m920222.信じる、信じないではありません。\n私はただ、語り継ぐためにこの場に存在するので:
It's not a matter of belief.
I am here simply to carry the story forward.
m920222.俺様を見くびるな。貴様の首なんぞいらん。\nただ、どうせ綺麗事を追いかけすぎて、:
Don't underestimate me. I have no use for your head.
I simply figured that you've chased after pretty ideals so far
that there's no turning back for you now.
m920222.停滞した世界じゃ、技術も発展しないですからね。: In a stagnant world, technology can't advance.
m920222.停滞せし安寧の世界か、\n希望の戦火が燃え盛る、正しき成長の世界か。\nお前がど:
Whether it is a stagnant world of peace,
or a world of righteous growth,
where the fires of hope burn bright.
Which future do you desire?
m920222.僕は、王子の思想を信じている。\n理想を掲げ、本当に素敵な未来を掴めると信じてい:
I believe in the Prince's philosophy.
I see hope in the way he holds up an ideal
and truly believes he can grasp a beautiful future.
m920222.僕はね、ユリクセス、\n君みたいな理想論者が、一番嫌いなんだ。:
You see, Ulyxes,
I despise idealists like you the most.
m920222.僕は雷神の使徒として、\nこの世界に殉じるつもりですから。:
I intend to devote my life to this world
as the Apostle of the Thunder God.
m920222.光の上に立てば、\nケラウノス様が力を貸してくださるはず……。\nどうか、この戦:
If we stand upon the light,
Lord Keraunos should lend us his power……
Please, grant us victory in this battle!
m920222.全て、伝わっているはずだ。\nこれ以上は、何を言っても無意味だろう。:
Everything should have already been conveyed.
Anything more would be meaningless.
m920222.内部に侵入するのは不可能だろうが……。\nそうか、連中、捨て身で飛行装置の出力低:
It should be impossible for them to breach the interior….
I see. They're sacrificing themselves to reduce the flight apparatus's output…
m920222.分かった分かった。\n戦士の照れ隠しは見苦しいぞ。\n――それより、戦闘準備を進:
Got it, got it.
A warrior's bashfulness is quite the sight to behold.
—Anyway, get ready for battle. They're probably on their way.
m920222.分かってる。\n……王子、行こう。ディアスとの決戦が待っている。:
I know.
……Prince, let's go. The final battle with Dias awaits.
m920222.分かってる。\n物質界連合主体で、\n離陸の妨害に来る連中を迎え撃つ準備はできて:
I know.
The Material Realm Coalition is leading the charge,
so we're all set to intercept whoever comes to stop our takeoff.
m920222.前を向き、進み続ける限り、\nそこには必ず争いが、嫉妬が、憎悪が存在する。:
As long as we keep looking forward and moving ahead,
there will always be conflict, jealousy, and hatred.
m920222.勝つさ。今回は、勝つ。: I'll win. This time, I will win.
m920222.勝手に恨め。\nそれで気が晴れるなら、いつでも殺しに来い。:
Hate me if you want.
If it clears your head, come kill me anytime.
m920222.勝者は、いつだって勝手なことを言うな……。: The victors always say such selfish things……
m920222.危うい女だ、お前は。\n王子のことも、その語り口で翻弄してやるがよい。:
You are a dangerous woman.
Go on, then. Keep the Prince spinning with that tone of yours.
m920222.同じ人ならば、と。\n嫉妬と悪意の火種には、それだけで十分。:
If they are the same, then.
That alone is enough to spark the fires of jealousy and malice.
m920222.同意見だ。\nそれも出てくるのは敵軍の将、ガレアのはず。:
Agreed.
And the one who comes out should be the enemy general, Galea.
m920222.向こう側の魔力が一切感知できないわけです。\nほぼ次元の断層に等しい、\n世界の:
We can't detect any magical energy on the other side at all.
It's practically a dimensional rift.
We'd need enough power to punch through the very wall of the world.
m920222.君に言われて、ようやく思い出したよ。\n僕は知将面して皆を率いる器じゃなかった。:
Hearing that from you, I finally remember.
I was never cut out to lead everyone while pretending to be a strategist.
m920222.君も、分かっているんだろう？\n人の時代などというものは、\n嘘で塗り固められた:
You know it, don't you?
The so-called "era of humanity" is nothing but
a hideous conflict built entirely on lies.
m920222.団長の創造主たるトラム様と、\n副団長ミルドリスに頭下げられて断れます……？: How could I refuse when Tram-sama, the Creator of the Order, and Vice-Commander Mildrith both bowed their heads to me?
m920222.地上でどれだけ惨事が起きようと、\nひとりの想いの方へ、旋律を寄せてしまうので。:
No matter how much tragedy unfolds on the surface,
I can't help but let my melody drift toward the one I care about.
m920222.地上の守りは、王子が絆を繋いできた皆と、\n元フィアナ騎士団のあたしにお任せを。:
Leave the ground defenses to the people you've forged bonds with,
and to me, a former member of the Fiana Knights.
m920222.地道な努力と、堅実な仕事が大切……です。: Steady effort and solid work are what matter...
m920222.垂直出撃ハッチ開くぞ！\nさぁ、行って来い、古のロマン！！:
Opening the vertical launch hatches!
Now, go get them, old romance!!
m920222.場合によっては、ここで殺すと？: Or should I kill you right here, depending on the situation?
m920222.変な女だ、まったく。\n殺意も感じないし、足止めしようという気迫もない。:
What a strange woman, truly.
No murderous intent, and no real resolve to hold us up, either.
m920222.夜空を流星が飾り、神話の夜は終わり、暁を迎えた。\nだから、たとえば――こういう:
Shooting stars adorned the night sky, the Night of Myth ended, and dawn arrived.
So, for example――how about this?
m920222.天使の輪と翼を持つゲイザー、か。\n確かに見覚えはないな。:
A Gazer with a halo and wings, huh.
I certainly have no memory of seeing one before.
m920222.天才肌のナナリーさんに言われると、\nなんというのか、説得力が……ないような。:
When you say that, Miss Genius,
it somehow lacks... persuasiveness.
m920222.女神ケラウノス……。\n簒奪者たる貴様が、よくも姿を現せたものだ。:
Goddess Keraunos……
You, the usurper, have the audacity to show your face before me.
m920222.学び……そうか、学びか。\nラムイエル、成長を望むのなら、お前も人類に付くか？:
Learned…… I see, learned.
Ramuel, if you seek to grow, will you side with humanity as well?
m920222.容姿も持ってる楽器も、噂とぴったり一致です。\n――歴史の観測者、ホルミース！:
Her appearance and her instrument match the rumors perfectly.
—The Observer of History, Holmes!
m920222.常に考え続けていたとも。\n王子が世界を、わずかながらも書き換えた、あの時から。: I have been thinking about it constantly. Ever since the Prince rewrote the world, even if only a little.
m920222.平行線、か。\n君とやり合うのは気が進まないが……。:
Parallel lines, huh.
I don't feel like fighting you, but…
m920222.弾頭の分割数を計算しましょう。\n十分な破壊力を維持しつつ、\nドーンブリンガー:
Let's calculate the number of warhead splits.
There must be a value that maintains sufficient destructive power
without blowing the Dawnbringer apart.
m920222.当然です。\nこの要塞が目覚めるのは、時代の終焉の時。\n滅びた世界に、記録は残:
However, on the land that has been destroyed time and again,
the traces of the thunder that scorched the entire surface
are etched in layers upon layers.
m920222.彼らに、人類の未来に殉じる覚悟があったとは、\nどうしても思えません。:
I simply cannot believe they were prepared
to sacrifice themselves for the future of humanity.
m920222.彼女は本来、こちらに付く必要はなかったのに。\n恩義のために命を賭けるなんて、\:
She never really needed to be here in the first place.
To risk her life out of gratitude...
I suppose I'll write a song in her honor.
m920222.待ちわびたぞ、王子。: I have waited for you, Prince.
m920222.待って、そんなことしたら、\n上昇時においていかれる君が、敵に囲まれることに……:
Wait, if you do that,
you'll be left behind during the ascent and surrounded by the enemy…
m920222.待て、王国各地でなく、\n物質界全土と言ったか！？\n最悪の予想ばかり当たるな…:
Hold on, not just the kingdom…
You said the entire Material World, right?
My worst fears keep coming true…
m920222.後で代金は払うさ。\n私も、これが終わったら\n一曲聴きたいと思っていたんだ。:
I'll pay you later.
I was actually hoping to hear a song after this was over.
m920222.心配無用だ。\n天界の民は、ツクヨミ殿の結界に守られている。\n天界の防衛なら人:
There's no need to worry.
The people of the Celestial Realm are protected by Tsukuyomi's barrier.
Apparently, defending the Celestial Realm doesn't count as aiding humanity.
m920222.心配無用！\n私はひとりではない。常に王子と、君たちがいる。\n距離が離れようと:
Don't worry!
I'm not alone. I have the Prince, and I have all of you.
Even if we're apart, our hearts are as one!
m920222.必ず、帰りましょう。\n誰ひとり欠けることなく、何でもない普通の日常に。:
We will definitely come back.
Not one of us missing, returning to our ordinary, everyday lives.
m920222.急いで伝えないと、いけないこと……？\n……はい。はい……えっ、えっと、えぇっ！:
Something you have to report immediately……?
……Yes. Yes……huh? Um, wha—!?
m920222.我が友、我が相棒、そしてその仲間たちよ！\nこれは、すべての時代に生きた人類と、:
My friend, my partner, and your comrades!
This is the battle to end the night of myths and seize a brilliant dawn,
fought by humanity across all eras.
m920222.我が友、我が相棒よ、\nこのまま出力を上げ、離脱をはかるのだ。:
My friend, my partner,
push the output to the max and break away!
m920222.我が存在理由は、ディアスさまただおひとり。: My reason for existing is Lord Dias alone.
m920222.我らの死をもって、\n新たな星は生み出され――ゼウスの鍵となる。:
Through our deaths,
a new star is born――and becomes the key to Zeus.
m920222.我ら天使は、神の力を分け与えられた、\nいわば力の結晶たる存在……。:
We angels are beings who have been granted a share of the divine power,
so to speak, crystals of power……
m920222.我ラも次の地点へ急ぐノダ！\n天使ノ出現報告ハ続々はいってイル！:
We need to rush to the next location!
Reports of the angels' appearance are pouring in!
m920222.提督……！\nはい、こちらも大丈夫です。:
Admiral…!
Yes, we're doing fine here.
m920222.数が多いな……。\n甲板に取りつかれる！ 提督、航空機動戦の指揮を！:
Quite a number….
They're swarming onto the deck! Admiral, take command of the aerial maneuver!
m920222.敵の本陣まで来たんだ。\n間違いなく、出てくるよ。:
We've reached the enemy's main base.
They'll definitely come out.
m920222.新しく作ってほしい魔法、\nなんていうのも、聞いてみたいわね。:
Or what kind of new magic you'd like us to create,
I'd like to hear that too.
m920222.新たに生まれた、星の概念そのもの……？: The very concept of newly born stars……?
m920222.既に無理をしたんだ。これ以上の無理はするな。\nパルセも、ドーンブリンガーも、\:
You've already pushed it too far. Don't push any further.
Paruse, the Dawnbringer……
they're both precious comrades to us now.
m920222.星が引っ張る力……重力だね。\n超古代文明は、星の外にも出ていたんだろうなぁ。:
The force that pulls the stars… gravity, right?
The ultra-ancient civilization must have ventured beyond the stars, too.
m920222.普段はふざけているくせに、\nこういう時だけかっこいいんだよな、あの人は。:
He's always joking around,
but he's cool only in moments like this.
m920222.来い、お前の絶望も、俺が受け止める。: Come at me. I'll take your despair, too.
m920222.来たか！\nフローガに艦の魔力探知機を任せた甲斐があった！:
Here they are!
I'm glad I entrusted the ship's magic detector to Floga!
m920222.来たようだね。\nならば、僕が出るしかないか。:
It seems they've arrived.
In that case, I suppose I have no choice but to come out.
m920222.正直、僕らの手には余る威力だ。\nあんなもの、撃ったらそれだけで歴史書に名前が残:
Honestly, the power of that weapon is beyond us.
Firing something like that would etch our names into history books on its own.
m920222.正直に言いなよ。\nここで時間を稼いだ方が、\nより面白い物語になるからだってさ:
Just be honest.
You're stalling here because
it makes for a more interesting story, don't you?
m920222.正直者だな、貴様は。\n敵としておくには、本当に惜しい男だ。:
You are an honest one.
You are truly a man I regret having as an enemy.
m920222.死んでいった仲間の無念を、\n僕にすがり涙する死にかけた者たちの怨嗟を、\n手の:
The unfulfilled regrets of the comrades who fell,
the resentment of those on the brink of death who clung to me,
the feelings of those drowning in tragedy beyond my reach.
m920222.水の星……なのでしょうか……？\n強い癒しの力を感じます。\nどうやら、敵の傷を:
A star of water……?
I feel a strong power of healing.
It seems to be mending the enemy's wounds.
m920222.渦巻く風が、星になっていく。\n風の星、ということか。:
The swirling wind is becoming a star.
A star of wind, I suppose.
m920222.然り！ 我ラの未来も、\nコノ戦いの趨勢にかかってイル！\n王子タチの帰ル場所ヲ:
That's right! Our future
depends on the outcome of this battle!
We will protect the place the Princes will return to!
m920222.王国の、いいえ、物質界の全ての者たちよ。\n真なる雷霆は、愚かなるあなた方を、\:
All who dwell in the kingdom, no, in the material world.
I swear that the true thunder
will continue to watch over you foolish ones.
m920222.王国軍、王子直属副官――私が突入の指揮を執る！\n総員、武器を取れ！:
Royal Army, Prince's Direct Adjutant—I will take command of the breach!
All units, take up your weapons!
--- scene: The Weavers of Human History (battle, start) ---
m920222.王子、おそらくこの戦闘中に、\n障壁の突破が可能になるはずだよ。:
Prince, it should be possible to break through the barrier
during this battle.
m920222.王子、この子は千年戦争で――: Prince, this child has been in the Millennium War for—
m920222.王子、これより私は、常にあなたと共にあります。: Prince, from this moment on, I shall always be with you.
m920222.王子、君の手をとるわけにはいかない。\nひどいことばかり、言ってしまったしね。:
Prince, I cannot take your hand.
I said so many terrible things.
m920222.王子、君はひとりではない。\n君に願いを託す者もまた、常に、君と共にある。:
Prince, you are not alone.
Those who entrusted their wishes to you are always with you.
m920222.王子、時間が経つと暴風が勢いを増していくようだ。\nこの風は刃も同然。気をつけろ:
Prince, the storm seems to be gaining strength as time passes.
This wind is as sharp as a blade. Be careful!
m920222.王子、物質界の各地点より緊急連絡です！\n多数の天使が出現！ 襲撃されています！:
Your Highness, we're receiving emergency reports from multiple locations in the Material World!
Numerous angels have appeared! They're under attack!
m920222.王子、王国の王子。\n君とはゆっくり、話をしたいと思っていた。:
Prince. The Prince of the Kingdom.
I had been hoping to have a long, leisurely chat with you.
m920222.王子が、こいつが何も苦労していないようなことを、\nあいつが言うとは思わなかった:
I never thought the Prince would say something
as if this guy hadn't suffered at all.
m920222.王子よ、この戦いは君たちだけの戦いではない。\n遥かな過去、私が造られた時代から:
Prince, this battle is not just yours alone.
It is the struggle between humanity's progress and despair,
continuing from the era when I was created, far in the past.
m920222.王子よ、世界の行く末は……貴様に託す……。: Prince, the fate of the world……is left in your hands…….
m920222.王子よ、我ら天使の命は、既に炉に焚べられた……。\nお前の手で、我らを終わらせて:
Prince, the lives of us angels have already been fed into the furnace……
Put an end to us with your own hands.
m920222.王子を神にするのではなく、\nただ、己の力のみを武具として委ねるとは。\n確かに:
Not making the Prince a god,
but entrusting only your own power to him as a weapon.
Indeed… perhaps the true thunder was always on your side.
m920222.王子ヨ、未来は任せたゾ……！！:
Prince, I leave the future in your hands...!!
--- scene: The Weavers of Human History ---
m920222.現に、小さな火種から生じた戦乱は、\n幾度もこの世界を滅ぼしてきた。:
In fact, wars born from such small sparks
have destroyed this world time and again.
m920222.理想を唱え、それを実現し続け、\nいつだって凡人の努力を、才能で踏みにじる。\n:
You preach ideals, keep realizing them,
and always trample on the efforts of ordinary people with your talent.
It was beings like you who drove the age forward, and who killed.
m920222.皆さんがまじめにお祈りをしてくれない、とか。: Or how you all never pray properly.
m920222.目覚めの時まで、\n時を稼いだその忠義に、応えてやらねばなるまい。:
I must repay the loyalty he showed me
by buying time until I woke.
m920222.確かさ、似たようなこと、前にやったよね。: I remember doing something similar before, right?
m920222.神たる者は、他者に何かを委ねはしない。\n何かを願うこともない。\n真なる神とは:
A god does not entrust anything to others.
Nor does a god wish for anything.
For a true god is one who answers wishes.
m920222.神など、見守っているくらいでちょうどいいのだ。\n首を突っ込むのは祭りの時だけ。:
Gods are best off just watching over things.
They only stick their noses in during festivals.
After all, gods are not the protagonists of this world.
m920222.神ならざる身をもって、神たる余を討たんとする者よ。\nこれこそが、世界の存続と滅:
You who would strike down a god like me, with a body that is not divine.
This is the Thunder of the End, the bolt that carries the world's survival and destruction.
The true form of my authority…
m920222.神に抗い、自由を勝ち取る。\n人の決意を尊ばぬ神などどこにいよう。:
To defy the gods and claim freedom.
No god who disrespects human resolve deserves worship.
m920222.神の庇護下にあり続ける世界では、\n今と何も、変わらないのだもの。: It would be exactly the same as it is now.
m920222.神の物語を終え、人の歴史を始めんとするならば、\n貴様の力を見せてみよ。\n人の:
If you would end the age of the gods and begin the age of men,
then show me the strength of your will.
Prove to me that human power alone can carry the world through the end of all things!
m920222.神も、変わることができる。\nもう気付いているはずだ。:
Even gods can change.
You must already know that.
m920222.神より授けられしメルカバーは、\n人の強さを知り、君に平和なる世界を託した。:
Mercur, granted by the gods,
knew the strength of man and entrusted you with a peaceful world.
m920222.神話の夜が終わったんだ。\n世界だって、移り変わっていくさ。:
The Night of Myth is over.
The world is bound to change with it.
m920222.私たちも、いずれ手が届くよ。\n今はこの船の力を借りているけど、\nいつかは自分:
We'll reach that point in time, too.
Right now, we're borrowing this ship's power, but
someday, we'll do it on our own.
m920222.私の助力など、もはや必要ありません。\n人類に必要なのは、ゆりかごではないのです:
I no longer need to lend my aid.
Humanity does not need a cradle.
Therefore, I will leave you with just one gift.
m920222.私は、あいつが目指す人類の未来とやらを、\n守ってやりたいと思っている。\nその:
I want to protect the future of humanity that he aims for.
If it's necessary for that, I won't hesitate to get my hands dirty.
m920222.私はこの後、裏切りますよ。: I'm going to betray you, you know.
m920222.私もまた、あなたと同じ、\n世界の滅びへの道を\n人の滅びをもって防ぐ者ですから:
I, too, am like you.
One who prevents the world's destruction
by sacrificing humanity.
m920222.空を灼くようなこの光……。\nウフフッ、あのユニコーンの小娘、\nちょっと無理し:
A light that scorches the sky...
Heh heh. It seems that unicorn girl
pushed herself a little too hard.
m920222.突入直前だもの。\nできるだけ、リラックスしておいた方がいいわ。:
We're right on the verge of breaching.
It's best to relax as much as possible.
m920222.竪琴……？\nへぇ、こんな戦場で詩人気取りかい？:
A harp...?
Hmph. Playing the poet on a battlefield, are you?
m920222.簒奪したのはどちらですか。\n創造神の不在をいいことに、世界の管理者を僭称すると:
Who is the usurper here?
Taking advantage of the Creator's absence to call yourself the world's administrator.
m920222.素直じゃねぇな、うちの軍師どもは。\nこういう時は、一言でいいんだよ。:
Our strategists aren't very good at being straightforward, are they.
In a moment like this, one word would do.
m920222.終焉要塞ゼウスでのやり取りを踏まえて考えると、\nこの世界の何かが、\n少しだけ:
Considering what happened at the Zeus Fortress,
I think something in this world
may have changed, just a little.
m920222.終焉要塞ゼウスは、星の力そのものを内包しています。\nこの、降り注ぐ流星は……。:
The End Fortress Zeus contains the very power of the stars.
These falling meteors are…….
m920222.総員迎撃態勢！\nドーンブリンガーに近付けさせないで！:
All hands, intercept formation!
Don't let them get close to the Dawnbringer!
m920222.考えたことは、ありますか？\n創造神が、なぜ世界を悲劇で満たしたのか。: Have you ever wondered why the Creator filled the world with tragedy?
m920222.自由を愛する亜神、戦場を求める者、\n理想を捨てきれぬ者、詩歌に命を捧げた者……:
The sub-god who loves freedom, the one who seeks the battlefield,
the one who cannot let go of ideals, the one who dedicated their life to poetry…
m920222.莫大な魔力の結晶が降り注いでるんだ。\nそれに、ひい爺さんの仕込みだぞ？\nどう:
A massive amount of crystallized mana is raining down.
And it's Grandpa's doing, too?
It's probably not a good thing.
m920222.落着地点では、\n少々不可解な事件が発生しているらしい。\n何というのか……うー:
At the landing site,
some rather inexplicable incident seems to have occurred.
How to put it… hmm…
m920222.行くぜヒュープ！\n最高の悪夢をみせてやるぜぇぇーーッ！！:
Let's go, Hupe!
I'm gonna show you the ultimate nightmareeee!!
m920222.街へ駆け込んできたゴブリン、\nまさかあいつから逃げていたのか……？:
The goblins that rushed into town...
Could they have been fleeing from that thing?
m920222.要塞宮殿の機能は、既に起動しているようです。\nあの球形の魔力障壁が見えますか？:
The Fortress Palace's systems appear to be active.
Can you see that spherical magical barrier?
It's blocking the space both physically and magically.
m920222.見事、だ……。\nもはや、悔いはない……。:
Splendid…….
I have no regrets left…….
m920222.計算は専門外だから、手伝えないのが口惜しいよ。: Calculations aren't my specialty, so it's frustrating that I can't help.
m920222.詩人の間じゃ有名な噂話でして。\nあらゆる戦場にふらりと現れ、\nただ詩を記録し:
There's a famous legend among poets.
A mysterious woman who wanders onto every battlefield,
records the events in verse, and then vanishes.
m920222.詩人はこういう時、\n慈愛ゆえに天罰を下す神に、優しさを感じるのです。:
Poets say that in moments like this,
they find tenderness in a god who brings down divine punishment out of compassion.
m920222.詩人はそういう生き物だ。\n私たち半神が、戦いに生きるのと同じだろう。:
That's just how poets are.
It's the same as how we demigods live for battle.
m920222.詩歌に命を捧げた君に言われたくはないな。\nさて、そろそろ彼らが来る頃だ。\n星:
I'd rather not hear that from you, who devoted your life to poetry.
Now, they should be arriving soon.
To end the mythic night of starlight and begin the age of men.
m920222.話が通じない……。\nいえ、話に一貫性がありすぎてむしろ困る……？:
I can't get through to her...
No, her logic is too consistent, and that's the problem...?
m920222.誰かのために戦い続ければ、\nいつか、この世界は良くなると信じていた。\n人類と:
I used to believe that if we kept fighting for someone,
this world would eventually become a better place.
It's a lie that humanity has clung to ever since it gained self-awareness.
m920222.誰もが、君のように、強くあり続けることはできない。\nそうだろう、王子。: Not everyone can stay as strong as you do, can they, Prince?
m920222.誰も悲しまない世界に到達できたなら、\nそれが、僕にとっての唯一の勝利だ。\nそ:
If I can reach a world where no one has to grieve,
that will be my only victory.
Even if I lose my life in the process.
m920222.調査中だと言っただろう。\n関連性までは、現時点では断言できない。:
I said I was still investigating.
I can't confirm any connection at this point.
m920222.諸君ラのたゆまぬ訓練のオカゲで、\nゴブリン軍団ハ、マスマスの発展を遂げタ！:
Thanks to your unrelenting training,
the Goblin Legion has achieved massive growth!
m920222.貴様、魂すべてを王子に委ねたと思っていたが、\nまだ動けるだけの余力があったのか:
I thought you had entrusted your entire soul to the Prince.
You still had enough strength left to move?
m920222.貴様の選択肢は、ふたつしかない。\n余の手を取り、創造神を継承するか――: Or end your journey right here.
m920222.貴様は、世界を変えられると思うか。\n己に、それだけの力があると思うか。:
Do you believe you can change the world?
Do you believe you possess that kind of power?
m920222.超時空騎フィンタンとのデータリンクもよし。\nパルセ、許容量を超えた計算は\nこ:
The data link with the Trans-Temporal Knight Fintan is good.
Paruse, if you have calculations that exceed your capacity,
feel free to dump them on us!
m920222.足場を踏み外し……いや、\n自分から、星に、墜ちていったのか……。:
He slipped from his footing…… no,
he fell into the stars of his own accord……
m920222.身長を伸ばす秘訣とか？: Or the secret to growing taller?
m920222.遠乗りにおすすめな場所、とか……。: Or the best places for a day trip...
m920222.鏡写しだと感じた男も、\n終生の好敵手と思っていた女も、\n誰も、僕のことを見て:
The man I saw as my mirror image,
and the woman I considered my lifelong rival,
no one was ever truly looking at me.
m920222.障壁は想定通りだが、出力が不明だな……。\nパルセ、魔力砲で突破可能か、計算を頼:
The barrier is as expected, but its output is unknown…
Paruse, calculate if we can break through with the magic cannon.
m920222.障壁を砕く算段もついたんだろう？\n無能な指揮官役は、もう終わりだ。\nここから:
You've figured out how to break the barrier, haven't you?
My days as a useless commander are over.
From here on, I'll face you as a warrior!
m920222.離反……離反か。\nラムイエル、お前も冗談を言うようになったな。\nあれはもとよ:
Defected… Defected, you say.
Ramuel, you've taken to making jokes.
He was never my subject to begin with.
m920222.願いと、決意は、確かに受け取った。: I have received your wishes and your resolve.
m920222.魔力装甲も万全、です！\n艦内侵入を防ぐ障壁も大丈夫……！:
The magic armor is perfect, too!
The barrier to prevent boarding is fine as well…!
m920222.鳥神様がいなくても、ぼくたちがついてる！\nだから――:
Even without the Bird God, we are with you!
So――
m920222.鳥籠の外が、素晴らしい世界だとは限らぬぞ。\n世界が真に破滅に向かった時、\nそ:
Do not assume the world beyond the cage is a wonderful place.
When the world truly heads toward ruin,
there will be no one left to stop it.
m920222.（……面白い人でした。\nあの人のことも、後で歌にしましょう）:
(...An interesting person.
I'll write a song about her, too, later on.)
m920222.（けれど、他人を理解することは、\nまだまだ苦手なようですね……。\nだって私の:
(But understanding others...
I still seem to be quite bad at it, don't I...
Because that song I played wasn't a requiem at all—)
